verdict.rationale: Trello offers building blocks for cross-tool and agent handoff. These include an MCP server to "connect Trello to any AI tool", a REST API with webhooks, batch and search, capture of details from email and Slack into the Inbox, Jira views, card mirroring, and plugin integrations. Cards can also hold rich context such as discussion threads. However, nothing documents agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff that explicitly preserves full context, and the MCP server is only a one-line claim. Missing for 10: documented handoff workflows that preserve context between agents, depth on MCP server capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration of lossless handoff.
